items.title: Descent along the blow-up square: compatible data on the centre and on the blow-up glue to an object of the derived category of the ambient scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the descent statement for the blow-up square: data K' on X' and L on Z with an identification of their pullbacks to E glue to an object K on X, functorially in morphisms (statement lines 23436-23469). The proof (proof lines 23471-23512) builds K by the blow-up descent triangle with the two structure maps defined by adjunction and by gamma, proves that both comparison maps are isomorphisms — the first by proper base change after restricting to Z, the second by the separate cases outside E and above E — and then normalises gamma and completes a map of triangles by the axioms of a triangulated category. H2: an explicit construction plus two isomorphism checks, all written out.
